differences.cause: The native encoder refuses a longitude of 180 degrees, a track number above 4095 and an altitude outside -1500 to 150000 ft. The pack writes any value the field holds; longitude 180 is written as 2^25.
opex="s" follows from three flags (testData, headerSimulated, simulated). The cot-xml pack has no field for opex.
The native encoder omits a zero fraction of a second; the library always writes milliseconds. The instant is the same.

The native encoder always writes a detail element, empty when it has no child. The library writes it only when it has a child.

The native encoder writes the confidence a second time, in the classification, when a classification exists. The pack maps confidence to detection_confidence only.
